<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ru">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Hyper shop — одежда и обувь</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Unbounded:wght@500;700;800&family=Instrument+Sans:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#ECEDEF; --surface:#F8F8F9; --ink:#101114; --muted:#585B63; --line:#CFD1D7;
  --accent:#2B22F0; --on-accent:#FFFFFF; --danger:#C4262E;
  --display:"Unbounded","Arial Black","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
  --body:"Instrument Sans","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
  box-sizing:border-box;
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);
  padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
    --bg:#0F1013; --surface:#17181C; --ink:#F1F2F4; --muted:#9A9DA6; --line:#2C2E35;
    --accent:#7A73FF; --on-accent:#0F1013; --danger:#FF6B72;
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  --bg:#0F1013; --surface:#17181C; --ink:#F1F2F4; --muted:#9A9DA6; --line:#2C2E35;
  --accent:#7A73FF; --on-accent:#0F1013; --danger:#FF6B72;
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:inherit}
html{scroll-padding-top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 72px);scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--body);font-size:1rem;line-height:1.5;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
img{display:block;max-width:100%}
button,input{font:inherit;color:inherit}
button{cursor:pointer}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px}
.wrap{width:min(1240px,100% - 40px);margin-inline:auto}

/* header */
.bar{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:20;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 88%,transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.bar .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:60px}
.logo{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:1.05rem;letter-spacing:.02em;text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink)}
.bar nav{display:flex;gap:28px;align-items:center}
.bar nav a{color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500;font-size:.95rem}
.bar nav a:hover{color:var(--accent)}
.cart-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:9px 16px;font-weight:600;font-size:.92rem}
.cart-btn .count{min-width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:11px;background:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:.78rem;padding:0 6px}
@media (max-width:640px){.bar nav a{display:none}}

/* hero */
.hero{padding:clamp(28px,5vw,64px) 0 clamp(40px,6vw,88px)}
.hero .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:clamp(24px,4vw,64px);align-items:end}
.mark{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;line-height:.88;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:0;font-size:clamp(3.4rem,13.5vw,11.5rem);text-transform:uppercase}
.mark span{display:block}
.mark .outline{color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:2px var(--ink)}
.hero-copy{max-width:34ch;margin:28px 0 28px;font-size:1.12rem;color:var(--muted)}
.cta{display:inline-block;background:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;padding:15px 26px;border-radius:999px}
.cta:hover{filter:brightness(1.08)}
.hero-pic{position:relative;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:4/5;background:var(--surface)}
.hero-pic img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.hero-pic figcaption{position:absolute;left:14px;bottom:14px;background:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent);padding:8px 14px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:600;font-size:.88rem}
.hero-pic{margin:0}
@media (max-width:860px){.hero .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero-pic{aspect-ratio:1/1}}

/* catalog */
.section-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:20px;border-top:1px solid var(--ink);padding-top:18px;margin-bottom:clamp(24px,4vw,48px)}
.section-head h2{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(1.4rem,3vw,2.2rem);margin:0;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.section-head p{margin:0;color:var(--muted)}
.product{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(24px,5vw,72px);align-items:center;margin-bottom:clamp(56px,8vw,120px)}
.product:nth-child(even) .pic{order:2}
.pic{border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface);aspect-ratio:3/4}
.pic img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.info{max-width:520px}
.brand{font-weight:600;color:var(--accent);margin:0 0 8px}
.info h3{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(1.7rem,3.6vw,2.7rem);line-height:1.05;margin:0 0 16px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.price{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:500;font-size:1.4rem;margin:0 0 20px}
.desc{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 22px;max-width:46ch}
.facts{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0 0 28px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.facts li{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.95rem}
.facts li span:first-child{color:var(--muted)}
.size-label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:10px}
.size-label small{font-weight:400;color:var(--muted)}
.sizes{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:20px}
.size{min-width:54px;height:48px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);border-radius:8px;font-weight:600}
.size:hover{border-color:var(--ink)}
.size[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);border-color:var(--ink)}
.add{width:100%;height:54px;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent);font-weight:600;font-size:1.02rem}
.add:hover{filter:brightness(1.08)}
.hint{min-height:1.4em;margin:10px 0 0;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--danger)}
@media (max-width:860px){.product{grid-template-columns:1fr}.product:nth-child(even) .pic{order:0}.info{max-width:none}}

/* how */
.how{background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);padding:clamp(48px,7vw,96px) 0}
.how h2{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(1.4rem,3vw,2.2rem);margin:0 0 36px}
.steps{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:28px;counter-reset:s}
.steps li{counter-increment:s;border-top:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 35%,transparent);padding-top:18px}
.steps li::before{content:counter(s);display:block;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:2.6rem;line-height:1;margin-bottom:14px}
.steps b{display:block;font-size:1.1rem;margin-bottom:4px}
.steps span{opacity:.75}
@media (max-width:760px){.steps{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

footer{padding:40px 0 56px}
footer .wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.92rem}
footer .logo{color:var(--ink)}

/* cart drawer */
.veil{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.5);z-index:30;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .2s}
.veil.open{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
.drawer{position:fixed;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;width:min(440px,100%);background:var(--surface);z-index:40;transform:translateX(100%);transition:transform .25s ease;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);border-left:1px solid var(--line)}
.drawer.open{transform:none}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.drawer,.veil{transition:none}html{scroll-behavior:auto}}
.drawer header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:18px 22px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.drawer h2{font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.15rem;margin:0}
.x{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent;font-size:1.2rem;line-height:1}
.lines{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:8px 22px}
.empty{color:var(--muted);padding:32px 0}
.line{display:grid;grid-template-columns:72px 1fr auto;gap:14px;padding:16px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);align-items:center}
.line img{width:72px;height:90px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:6px}
.line b{display:block;line-height:1.25}
.line small{color:var(--muted)}
.qty{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:8px}
.qty button{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent}
.rm{border:0;background:none;color:var(--muted);text-decoration:underline;font-size:.85rem;align-self:start}
.line .sum{font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
.checkout{padding:18px 22px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);display:grid;gap:10px}
.total{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:600;font-size:1.1rem}
.checkout input{height:46px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);border-radius:8px;padding:0 14px}
.order{height:52px;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent);font-weight:600}
.order:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}
.result{display:none;padding:18px 22px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);gap:10px}
.result.show{display:grid}
.result textarea{width:100%;min-height:150px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);border-radius:8px;padding:12px;font:inherit;font-size:.9rem}
.result .row{display:flex;gap:8px}
.result button,.result a{flex:1;height:46px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--ink);background:transparent;font-weight:600;display:grid;place-items:center;text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink)}
.result a{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent)}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header class="bar">
  <div class="wrap">
    <a class="logo" href="#top">HYPER SHOP</a>
    <nav>
      <a href="#catalog">Каталог</a>
      <a href="#how">Как заказать</a>
      <button class="cart-btn" id="openCart" aria-label="Открыть корзину">Корзина <span class="count" id="count">0</span></button>
    </nav>
  </div>
</header>

<main id="top">
  <section class="hero">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div>
        <h1 class="mark"><span>Hyper</span><span class="outline">Shop</span></h1>
        <p class="hero-copy">Одежда и обувь. Выберите размер, добавьте в корзину и оформите заказ.</p>
        <a class="cta" href="#catalog">Смотреть каталог</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="catalog">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="section-head">
        <h2>Каталог</h2>
        <p>2 модели в наличии</p>
      </div>
      <div id="products"></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="how" id="how">
    <div class="wrap">
      <h2>Как заказать</h2>
      <ol class="steps">
        <li><b>Выберите размер</b><span>Откройте нужную модель и нажмите на свой размер.</span></li>
        <li><b>Добавьте в корзину</b><span>Проверьте состав заказа и итоговую сумму.</span></li>
        <li><b>Отправьте заказ</b><span>Оставьте имя и телефон — мы свяжемся и уточним детали.</span></li>
      </ol>
    </div>
  </section>
</main>

<footer>
  <div class="wrap">
    <a class="logo" href="#top">HYPER SHOP</a>
    <span>© 2026 Hyper shop</span>
  </div>
</footer>

<div class="veil" id="veil"></div>
<aside class="drawer" id="drawer" aria-label="Корзина" aria-hidden="true">
  <header>
    <h2>Корзина</h2>
    <button class="x" id="closeCart" aria-label="Закрыть корзину">×</button>
  </header>
  <div class="lines" id="lines"></div>
  <form class="checkout" id="checkout" novalidate>
    <div class="total"><span>Итого</span><span id="total">0 ₽</span></div>
    <input id="name" placeholder="Ваше имя" autocomplete="name">
    <input id="phone" placeholder="Телефон" autocomplete="tel" inputmode="tel">
    <button class="order" id="orderBtn" type="submit" disabled>Оформить заказ</button>
  </form>
  <div class="result" id="result">
    <b>Заказ сформирован</b>
    <textarea id="orderText" readonly></textarea>
    <div class="row">
      <button type="button" id="copyBtn">Скопировать</button>
      <a id="sendLink" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener" hidden>Отправить в Telegram</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</aside>

<script>
/* ===== Настройки магазина — меняйте здесь ===== */
const CONTACT_TG = ""; // например "hypershop_manager" (без @) — появится кнопка отправки заказа в Telegram
const IMG = {
  sneakers: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  sweater:  "data:image/jpeg;base64,"
};
const PRODUCTS = [
  {
    id: "gg-superstar", brand: "Golden Goose", name: "Super-Star", price: 1650,
    img: IMG.sneakers, alt: "Чёрные кроссовки Golden Goose Super-Star с белой замшевой звездой",
    desc: "Культовые низкие кроссовки из чёрной кожи с белой замшевой звездой, потёртой подошвой и фирменными шнурками.",
    facts: [["Цвет", "Чёрный / белый"], ["Материал", "Кожа, замша"], ["Подошва", "Состаренная резина"]],
    sizes: [36, 37, 38, 39, 40, 41], sizeNote: "EU"
  },
  {
    id: "si-knit", brand: "Stone Island", name: "Вязаная кофта", price: 3300,
    img: IMG.sweater, alt: "Чёрно-белая вязаная кофта Stone Island с нашивкой-компасом на рукаве",
    desc: "Крупная вязка в чёрно-белую полоску, круглый ворот и фирменная нашивка с компасом на рукаве.",
    facts: [["Цвет", "Чёрный / белый"], ["Вязка", "Крупная, рельефная"], ["Деталь", "Нашивка-компас на рукаве"]],
    sizes: ["S", "M", "L", "XL"], sizeNote: ""
  }
];
/* ============================================== */

const $ = s => document.querySelector(s);
const fmt = n => n.toLocaleString("ru-RU") + " ₽";
let cart = [];
try { cart = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("hypershop-cart") || "[]"); } catch (e) { cart = []; }
const save = () => { try { localStorage.setItem("hypershop-cart", JSON.stringify(cart)); } catch (e) {} };
const byId = id => PRODUCTS.find(p => p.id === id);
const picked = {};

$("#products").innerHTML = PRODUCTS.map(p => `
  <article class="product" id="${p.id}">
    <div class="pic"><img src="${p.img}" alt="${p.alt}" loading="lazy"></div>
    <div class="info">
      <p class="brand">${p.brand}</p>
      <h3>${p.name}</h3>
      <p class="price">${fmt(p.price)}</p>
      <p class="desc">${p.desc}</p>
      <ul class="facts">${p.facts.map(f => `<li><span>${f[0]}</span><span>${f[1]}</span></li>`).join("")}</ul>
      <div class="size-label"><span>Размер</span>${p.sizeNote ? `<small>${p.sizeNote}</small>` : ""}</div>
      <div class="sizes" role="group" aria-label="Размер">
        ${p.sizes.map(s => `<button type="button" class="size" data-p="${p.id}" data-s="${s}" aria-pressed="false">${s}</button>`).join("")}
      </div>
      <button type="button" class="add" data-add="${p.id}">Добавить в корзину</button>
      <p class="hint" id="hint-${p.id}" role="alert"></p>
    </div>
  </article>`).join("");

document.addEventListener("click", e => {
  const sz = e.target.closest(".size");
  if (sz) {
    const id = sz.dataset.p; picked[id] = sz.dataset.s;
    document.querySelectorAll(`.size[data-p="${id}"]`).forEach(b => b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", b === sz ? "true" : "false"));
    $("#hint-" + id).textContent = "";
    return;
  }
  const add = e.target.closest("[data-add]");
  if (add) {
    const id = add.dataset.add;
    if (!picked[id]) { $("#hint-" + id).textContent = "Выберите размер, чтобы добавить в корзину."; return; }
    const ex = cart.find(i => i.id === id && i.size === picked[id]);
    if (ex) ex.qty++; else cart.push({ id, size: picked[id], qty: 1 });
    save(); render(); openCart();
    return;
  }
  const act = e.target.closest("[data-act]");
  if (act) {
    const i = +act.dataset.i, it = cart[i];
    if (act.dataset.act === "inc") it.qty++;
    if (act.dataset.act === "dec") it.qty = Math.max(1, it.qty - 1);
    if (act.dataset.act === "rm") cart.splice(i, 1);
    save(); render();
  }
});

function render() {
  const n = cart.reduce((a, i) => a + i.qty, 0);
  const sum = cart.reduce((a, i) => a + i.qty * byId(i.id).price, 0);
  $("#count").textContent = n;
  $("#total").textContent = fmt(sum);
  $("#lines").innerHTML = cart.length ? cart.map((it, i) => {
    const p = byId(it.id);
    return `<div class="line">
      <img src="${p.img}" alt="">
      <div><b>${p.brand} ${p.name}</b><small>Размер ${it.size} · ${fmt(p.price)}</small>
        <div class="qty"><button type="button" data-act="dec" data-i="${i}" aria-label="Меньше">−</button><span>${it.qty}</span><button type="button" data-act="inc" data-i="${i}" aria-label="Больше">+</button></div>
      </div>
      <div><div class="sum">${fmt(p.price * it.qty)}</div><button type="button" class="rm" data-act="rm" data-i="${i}">Убрать</button></div>
    </div>`;
  }).join("") : `<p class="empty">В корзине пока пусто. Выберите размер в каталоге и добавьте товар.</p>`;
  $("#orderBtn").disabled = !cart.length;
  $("#result").classList.remove("show");
}

function openCart() { $("#drawer").classList.add("open"); $("#veil").classList.add("open"); $("#drawer").setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false"); $("#closeCart").focus(); }
function closeCart() { $("#drawer").classList.remove("open"); $("#veil").classList.remove("open"); $("#drawer").setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true"); $("#openCart").focus(); }
$("#openCart").addEventListener("click", openCart);
$("#closeCart").addEventListener("click", closeCart);
$("#veil").addEventListener("click", closeCart);
document.addEventListener("keydown", e => { if (e.key === "Escape") closeCart(); });

$("#checkout").addEventListener("submit", e => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const name = $("#name").value.trim(), phone = $("#phone").value.trim();
  if (!name || !phone) { (name ? $("#phone") : $("#name")).focus(); return; }
  const lines = cart.map(i => { const p = byId(i.id); return `• ${p.brand} ${p.name}, размер ${i.size}, ${i.qty} шт. — ${fmt(p.price * i.qty)}`; });
  const sum = cart.reduce((a, i) => a + i.qty * byId(i.id).price, 0);
  const text = `Заказ Hyper shop\n${lines.join("\n")}\nИтого: ${fmt(sum)}\n\nИмя: ${name}\nТелефон: ${phone}`;
  $("#orderText").value = text;
  const link = $("#sendLink");
  if (CONTACT_TG) { link.href = `https://t.me/${CONTACT_TG}?text=${encodeURIComponent(text)}`; link.hidden = false; } else { link.hidden = true; }
  $("#result").classList.add("show");
});
$("#copyBtn").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const t = $("#orderText"); t.select();
  try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(t.value); } catch (e) { document.execCommand("copy"); }
  $("#copyBtn").textContent = "Скопировано";
  setTimeout(() => $("#copyBtn").textContent = "Скопировать", 1800);
});

render();
</script>
</body>
</html>
